From 702d1e81feae70aa16ca364b4d2d95ccad801022 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Terry Zhou <bjzhou@marvell.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2018 10:44:05 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] pinctrl: armada-37xx: Fix spurious irq management

Until now, if we found spurious irq in irq_handler, we only updated the
status in register but not the status in the code. Due to this the system
will got stuck dues to the infinite loop

[gregory.clement@bootlin.com: update comment and add fix and stable tags]
Fixes: 30ac0d3b0702 ("pinctrl: armada-37xx: Add edge both type gpio irq support")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Terry Zhou <bjzhou@marvell.com>
Reviewed-by: Gregory CLEMENT <gregory.clement@bootlin.com>
Signed-off-by: Gregory CLEMENT <gregory.clement@bootlin.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/pinctrl/mvebu/pinctrl-armada-37xx.c b/drivers/pinctrl/mvebu/pinctrl-armada-37xx.c
index 0f1eafba0ded..674ffdf8103c 100644
--- a/drivers/pinctrl/mvebu/pinctrl-armada-37xx.c
+++ b/drivers/pinctrl/mvebu/pinctrl-armada-37xx.c
@@ -666,12 +666,13 @@ static void armada_37xx_irq_handler(struct irq_desc *desc)
 					writel(1 << hwirq,
 					       info->base +
 					       IRQ_STATUS + 4 * i);
-					continue;
+					goto update_status;
 				}
 			}
 
 			generic_handle_irq(virq);
 
+update_status:
 			/* Update status in case a new IRQ appears */
 			spin_lock_irqsave(&info->irq_lock, flags);
 			status = readl_relaxed(info->base +
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/pinctrl/mvebu/pinctrl-armada-37xx.c`**
   - The line `continue;` was replaced with `goto update_status;` within the `armada_37xx_irq_handler` function. This change alters the flow of the function to ensure that when a spurious IRQ is detected, the code will jump to the `update_status` label instead of continuing the loop. 
   - The `update_status` label is introduced to handle the updating of the IRQ status, ensuring that the status is updated correctly in the code when a spurious IRQ is encountered.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `pinctrl-armada-37xx.c` file addresses a bug related to spurious IRQ management. By changing the control flow from a `continue` statement to a `goto` statement, the patch ensures that the IRQ status is updated properly in the code, preventing the system from getting stuck in an infinite loop. This change is crucial for maintaining the correct behavior of the IRQ handler, thereby improving the stability of the system when handling spurious interrupts. The patch also includes a comment update and adds fix and stable tags, indicating its relevance for future kernel stability.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
writel(1 << hwirq, info->base + IRQ_STATUS + 4 * i);
continue;
```
Reason:
The IRQ handler only acknowledged the spurious IRQ by updating the status in the register but did not update the status in the code. This led to the handler entering an infinite loop because it failed to re-evaluate the status of the IRQs after handling a spurious IRQ, causing the system to get stuck.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
goto update_status;
```
```c
status = readl_relaxed(info->base + IRQ_STATUS + 4 * i);
```
Reason:
The addition of the `goto update_status;` statement ensures that after handling a spurious IRQ, the handler will update the status in the code by re-reading the IRQ status. This prevents the infinite loop by allowing the handler to correctly process any new IRQs that may have appeared, thus ensuring proper IRQ management.
